title: Permission-holders with no recent activity
description: Permission-holders with no recorded activity in any repo within the selected period; 'All time' lists those with no recorded activity at all. Useful for keeping access lists current. A blank 'days since active' means no recorded activity yet. The 'quiet permission-holders' KPI tile above stays at a fixed 180-day threshold regardless of the tab.

columns.label: highest role
columns.description: The most senior governance role this user holds anywhere: maintainer, committer, triage, or general.

columns.label: roles held
columns.description: All governance roles this user holds, across repositories.

columns.label: repos
columns.description: Number of repositories where this user holds a governance role.

columns.label: days since active
columns.description: Days since this user's last recorded activity. Blank means no recorded activity yet.

columns.label: last active
columns.description: The most recent date this user had any tracked activity, across all repositories.
